mapper.sql: user_pk, company, department, user_name, user_id, user_id_norm, password_hash, email, status, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_user_info (company, department, user_name, user_id, user_id_norm, password_hash, email, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{u.company}, #{u.department}, #{u.userName}, #{u.userId}, #{u.userIdNorm}, #{u.passwordHash}, #{u.email}, COALESCE(#{u.status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, 'ACTIVE'), COALESCE(#{u.createdBy}, 'SYSTEM'), COALESCE(#{u.updatedBy}, 'SYSTEM'))
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_user_info SET company = #{u.company}, department = #{u.department}, user_name = #{u.userName}, user_id = #{u.userId}, user_id_norm = #{u.userIdNorm}, password_hash = #{u.passwordHash}, email = #{u.email}, status = COALESCE(#{u.status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, status), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = COALESCE(#{u.updatedBy}, 'SYSTEM') WHERE user_pk = #{u.userPk}

UPDATE tc_user_info SET company = #{u.company}, department = #{u.department}, user_name = #{u.userName}, user_id = #{u.userId}, user_id_norm = #{u.userIdNorm}, password_hash = #{u.passwordHash}, email = #{u.email}, status = COALESCE(#{u.status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, status), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = COALESCE(#{u.updatedBy}, 'SYSTEM') WHERE user_id_norm = #{u.userIdNorm}
